name: Muzzle flash set (per-family) + barrel smoke wisp
materialSlots: additive star sprites (pistol cross / smg / rifle star / shotgun bloom / sniper long)
textures: procedural canvas star variants per family
lod: pooled sprites; count scales with renderer particles scalar
animations: 2-frame flash (random roll per shot via cosmeticRng) + forward spike on long guns + 0.5s smoke wisp; point light decays within a single frame at 60Hz (decay 34/s)
audio: fired by weapon audio, not owned here
acceptance: families distinguishable in a dark room; flash briefly illuminates nearby enemies in dark zones; no lingering glow

name: Surface impact set
materialSlots: per-material chip geometry (concrete chips, drywall powder, wood splinters, metal sparks + ring, glass glitter, carpet fluff, snow puff)
lod: pooled; particle counts scale with quality scalar
animations: gravity chips + fading dust, metal spark ring flash; chips carry slight per-particle jitter of the surface tint (WP-013b)
acceptance: material identifiable from impact alone at 3m; particles read as coming off the surface color

name: Tracer streak
materialSlots: thin additive line, warm tint, opacity 0.6
acceptance: visible but subtle; does not read as a laser

name: Ejected casings (per-family size/color)
acceptance: shotgun hulls visibly different from brass; sizes scale with family

name: Glass burst shards + glitter twinkle
animations: shards fall under gravity with tumble, clamp at floor level, despawn ~1s; glitter twinkles 0.6s
acceptance: burst reads as safety glass; debris respects gravity and never sinks below the floor; no shards persist

name: Blood puff + small floor decal
acceptance: restrained, dark; fully suppressed by reducedBlood setting (decals included)

name: SG-2 smoke volume
materialSlots: 14 lit billow sprites (inner core + outer shell, fake top-lighting)
collision: none (LOS blocking via isSmoked segment test)
animations: 1.5s bloom with smoothstep soft-edge fade-in, ~16s hold with slow pulse, 3s soft dissolve (WP-013b edge softness)
acceptance: holds shape ~16s; AI LOS blocked through the volume; readable silhouette

name: FB-3 flash burst + lingering sparkle
acceptance: clear white pop + sparkle without persisting glow; screen-white handled by UI

name: Ambient exterior snowfall
acceptance: soft round flakes (no squares); no interior leakage

name: Sunbeam dust motes
materialSlots: tiny additive points, very low opacity
acceptance: visible only against light shafts; near-zero cost

name: Cold-air breath vapor
locations: characters in exterior zones + cold interiors (garage, loading dock)

acceptance: subtle; exterior + garage/loading only — never in warm offices (WP-013b gate verified)
